remarks: Exceptionally bright & airy, this newer 1 bed/1-bath privately situated corner apartment features: extra windows, contemporary design, open floor plan, southwest skyline views & a variety of amenities to complement your life! Located on the brim of exciting downtown Stamford in a secure, well managed community, residents will enjoy an open kitchen, fully equipped with granite & stainless, living spaces lined with big windows, a spacious & sparkling full bath with subway tile, in-unit laundry, on-site 24-hour security, reserved garage parking, a well-appointed fitness center and awesome rooftop deck to take in the outdoors and enjoy panoramic cityscape views. Adding to the features is a 5-star energy rating and absolutely NO ADDITIONAL FEES!  Pets are welcome at Park 215, here are the limits: 1 dog - 35lbs, 2 cats, or 1 dog and 1 cat OK. Interested applicants must complete a Park 215 Application uploaded in supplements and credit check through Apply Connect only. Park 215 is a no smoking community.
